  ## How AI-Enabled Planning Will Improve Your Supply Chain Performance
  
  Extreme volatility, inventory shortages and data overload are all challenges businesses are facing
  when it comes to supply chain planning. AI-enabled planning capabilities can address these
  challenges by improving decision-making, agility, and collaboration across supply chain functions.
  [][96]
  
  ## 2026 Supply Chain Compass: How Supply Chain leaders are navigating complexity
  
  The Supply Chain Compass 2026 report surveys nearly 700 supply chain leaders, exploring how they
  are navigating a rapidly evolving landscape shaped by AI, disruption, and rising expectations.
  While nearly half express strong optimism about the future, the report reveals that this
  confidence is driven by greater visibility, stronger technology adoption, and more integrated,
  data-driven supply chain strategies.
  [][97]
  
  ## Beyond Silos: Evolving to an Enterprise Supply Chain
  
  Incisiv explores the significant transformation underway in modern supply chains, detailing the
  shift away from fragmented processes and point solutions to more agile platforms and collaborative
  workflows. This evolution addresses systemic issues such as inflexibility and disconnected
  communication, enhancing supply chain responsiveness, sustainability, and profitability.

  ## How AI-Enabled Planning Will Improve Your Supply Chain Performance

  when it comes to supply chain planning. AI-enabled planning capabilities can address these
  challenges by improving decision-making, agility, and collaboration across supply chain functions.

  ## 2026 Supply Chain Compass: How Supply Chain leaders are navigating complexity
  
  The Supply Chain Compass 2026 report surveys nearly 700 supply chain leaders, exploring how they
  are navigating a rapidly evolving landscape shaped by AI, disruption, and rising expectations.
  While nearly half express strong optimism about the future, the report reveals that this
  confidence is driven by greater visibility, stronger technology adoption, and more integrated,
  data-driven supply chain strategies.
  [][97]
  
  ## Beyond Silos: Evolving to an Enterprise Supply Chain
  
  Incisiv explores the significant transformation underway in modern supply chains, detailing the
  shift away from fragmented processes and point solutions to more agile platforms and collaborative
  workflows. This evolution addresses systemic issues such as inflexibility and disconnected
  communication, enhancing supply chain responsiveness, sustainability, and profitability.

  The Supply Chain Compass 2026 report surveys nearly 700 supply chain leaders, exploring how they
  are navigating a rapidly evolving landscape shaped by AI, disruption, and rising expectations.
  While nearly half express strong optimism about the future, the report reveals that this
  confidence is driven by greater visibility, stronger technology adoption, and more integrated,
  data-driven supply chain strategies.
  [][97]
  
  ## Beyond Silos: Evolving to an Enterprise Supply Chain
  
  Incisiv explores the significant transformation underway in modern supply chains, detailing the
  shift away from fragmented processes and point solutions to more agile platforms and collaborative
  workflows. This evolution addresses systemic issues such as inflexibility and disconnected
  communication, enhancing supply chain responsiveness, sustainability, and profitability.

## MAP Sensor

## What you worry about, solved

### 01. Can’t find the exact sensor match?

Many trucks share the same engine but use different sensors by year or connector, so easy to order
the wrong part.
Send us your VIN + old-part photos, and our engineers will match OE numbers, connector type and
length before we quote and ship, cutting wrong deliveries and returns.

[ Contact Us ][11]

### 02. Not sure about goods quality?

Aftermarket parts vary, disputes in warranty.
Every batch goes through 100% inbound & outbound testing, key models get high/low temperature and
life-cycle bench tests, and each carton has a traceable batch code plus warranty support.

[ Contact Us ][12]

### 03. How do you secure shipping?

We keep safety stock on core SKUs, so most orders ship within 24–48 hours.
courier/air/sea options and full tracking with lead-time commitment help you avoid stock gaps and
costly downtime.

[ Contact Us ][13]

## WHY CHOOSE US

[ Predictable supply for wholesale programs ][14]

Multi-warehouse strategy in China with rolling safety stock on core SKUs. Weekly capacity planning
ensures stable availability during peaks. 

[ Cross-border logistics you can plan around ][15]

Consolidated shipping, export documents ready (commercial invoice, packing list, HS codes), and
carrier options for air/sea. Clear lead-time tiers: 5 days ex-works, 7-15 days door-to-door to
EU/LatAm hubs.

[ Total landed cost advantage without quality trade-offs ][16]

Tiered pricing for volume, fixed packing specs, and optimized cartons to reduce dimensional weight.
Batch-level traceability keeps warranty risk low.

[ Quality you can trace, warranty you can rely on ][17]

Two-stage QC (inbound/outbound), serialized labels, and retained samples by lot. Warranty terms
aligned for wholesale replacements and credit notes.

[ VIN and photo-matching that reduces returns ][18]

Fast model/connector verification before purchase via VIN and old-part photos. (48h confirmation
window) Low return rate on core SKUs (<0.8% rolling 12 months).

[ Compliance and documentation ready for customs ][19]

IATF 16949 processes, RoHS material declarations, IP ratings where applicable, MSDS and test reports
available per request. Smooth customs clearance reduces delays.

[ Flexible payment and risk control ][20]

Multiple trade terms (EXW/FOB/CIF/DDP by arrangement), payment options (T/T, L/C for qualified
partners), and credit lines for long-term distributors.

[ Post-sale support built for distributors ][21]

Installation guides, failure analysis reports within 3 business days, and RMA portal designed for
batch handling. Root-cause feedback loops to protect your brand.

## ABOUT US

Depth Technology Limited, headquartered in Hong Kong, is a specialized manufacturer and exporter of
high-quality truck components, with a strong focus on precision sensors for heavy-duty vehicles.
Leveraging robust production capabilities and a global outlook, we serve clients across
international markets.

Core Business

Our core business centers on the manufacturing and export of truck parts, especially sensors (e.g.,
Map sensor and Maf sensor). We supply a full range of components—from engine systems to chassis
parts—tailored for brands like Sinotruk, Shacman, and FAW. Our products are exported to regions
including Russia, Southeast Asia,Middle East, Africa, and Europe.

Running a business involves wearing many different hats and, making sure that as you grow and expand

[ Call us to discuss your specific business insurance needs and for a quote ][54]

Business insurance protection for the unexpected

Running a business involves wearing many different hats and, making sure that as you grow and expand
your business, you are well protected against the various risks you face. BTC Insurance Services LLC
is here to help protect your hard work and serve as an integral part of your continued success. We
offer risk management and commercial insurance solutions that include the full gamut of coverages,
with our experienced professionals at BTC Insurance ready to customize programs designed to respond
in the event things go awry.

 

We also provide personal insurance to our business clients and residents throughout Utah.

[ Get to know us ][55]
[Home][Home]
[image][image]

We Value Our Client Relationships

You can obtain a policy from anywhere. At BTC Insurance, we work a little differently than most
independent insurance agencies. Our goal is to ensure that we are the right fit for your insurance
and risk management needs, not to simply sell you a policy or two. That means having some in-depth
conversations to determine how we can best meet your needs. If we aren’t a fit, we’ll let you know
immediately. When we are, you can rely on us to exceed your expectations, secure the business
coverages you require, obtain the surety bonds you need to win new projects, and serve as your
advocate if a loss occurs. Our high level of integrity, trust and transparency are the hallmarks
behind the longstanding, mutually beneficial relationships we have with our clients.

Putting Our Knowledge to Work

We’ll perform a thorough review of your business needs and pinpoint blind spots where exposures may
leave you vulnerable and areas where we can improve your insurance protection. Our market access and
relationships with insurance carriers enables us to tailor products and specialty programs for
businesses at competitive pricing. Just click on any of the products or programs below to learn how
we can help protect your business, you and your family.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about Catalist and the order aggregation model.

### What is Catalist AI?

Catalist AI is an AI-native B2B marketplace that connects professional buyers with premium brands
through order aggregation. The platform provides brand-direct supply chain access with
enterprise-grade documentation, eliminating minimum order requirements while ensuring complete chain
of custody transparency for every order.

### How does order aggregation eliminate minimum order requirements?

Catalist combines purchase requests from multiple verified professional buyers to meet manufacturer
volume requirements collectively. Each buyer orders only the quantity they need while the platform
ensures minimums are satisfied. Every order includes complete documentation tracing directly to the
manufacturer source.

### What brands are available through Catalist?

### What is Catalist AI?

Catalist AI is an AI-native B2B marketplace that connects professional buyers with premium brands
through order aggregation. The platform provides brand-direct supply chain access with
enterprise-grade documentation, eliminating minimum order requirements while ensuring complete chain
of custody transparency for every order.

### How does order aggregation eliminate minimum order requirements?

Catalist combines purchase requests from multiple verified professional buyers to meet manufacturer
volume requirements collectively. Each buyer orders only the quantity they need while the platform
ensures minimums are satisfied. Every order includes complete documentation tracing directly to the
manufacturer source.

multi-channel retailers that address numerous workflow challenges. This includes solutions for

outbound shipping. Our custom integrated warehouse, distribution, and fulfillment systems draw from
a deep pool of conventional, semi-automated, and automated material handling technologies.

## FAQs

What is an SBOM and why does it matter?

A Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) is a detailed inventory of every component inside your software,
including open-source libraries, dependencies, and third-party code. It helps you identify hidden
vulnerabilities, manage licensing risk, and comply with regulations like EO 14028 and NIST 800-218.

How does Manifest generate SBOMs?

Manifest automates SBOM generation across your entire application fleet,  in seconds. We support
formats like SPDX, CycloneDX, and VEX, and go beyond repositories to analyze binaries, embedded
code, and real-world deployments.

How is Manifest different from traditional SCA tools?

Traditional Software Composition Analysis (SCA) tools scan individual repos and often generate noisy
alerts. Manifest offers universal technology transparency, assessing risk across your entire product
line, including non-CVE threats, committer insights, and AI models.

How often should I update my SBOMs?

SBOMs should be generated continuously, not just when a product is released. Manifest supports
real-time SBOM monitoring, enrichment, and vulnerability tracking so your inventory stays accurate,
actionable, and audit-ready.

## FAQs

What is an SBOM and why does it matter?

A Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) is a detailed inventory of every component inside your software,
including open-source libraries, dependencies, and third-party code. It helps you identify hidden
vulnerabilities, manage licensing risk, and comply with regulations like EO 14028 and NIST 800-218.

How does Manifest generate SBOMs?

Manifest automates SBOM generation across your entire application fleet,  in seconds. We support
formats like SPDX, CycloneDX, and VEX, and go beyond repositories to analyze binaries, embedded
code, and real-world deployments.

How is Manifest different from traditional SCA tools?

Traditional Software Composition Analysis (SCA) tools scan individual repos and often generate noisy
alerts. Manifest offers universal technology transparency, assessing risk across your entire product
line, including non-CVE threats, committer insights, and AI models.

How often should I update my SBOMs?

SBOMs should be generated continuously, not just when a product is released. Manifest supports
real-time SBOM monitoring, enrichment, and vulnerability tracking so your inventory stays accurate,
actionable, and audit-ready.

than panic. This troubleshooting hub covers practical steps I use when a USB/OLED hardware wallet
doesn't do what I expect: won’t boot, won’t pair, refuses firmware updates, or shows suspicious
behavior. I’ve tested multiple devices since 2018 and learned that most problems are solvable with
clear steps (and some patience). What I've found: a methodical approach saves coins.

This page focuses on common faults and recovery patterns. For step-by-step setup or a full recovery
walkthrough see the [setup guide][103] and [restore & recover wallet][104] pages.

## Quick fixes: setup & unboxing

Common symptoms immediately after unboxing:
* Device won't power on or stays on a black screen.
* No recognition on desktop or mobile.
* Setup freezes during create/restore.

Quick checks I run first:

[[Try Tangem secure wallet →]][105]
1. Try a different USB cable and port. Cheap cables can be power-only.
2. Boot the host computer in normal mode (not guest/VM) and watch for driver prompts.
3. Confirm you have the official setup steps from the [setup-unboxing][106] page (never follow a
   random YouTube shortcut).

And one more: test on a second machine (or mobile via OTG) to rule out host-side problems.

## PIN, reset, and recovery flow

PIN problems are common. Forgetting a PIN does not mean loss of funds — if you have your seed phrase
you can always recover. But repeated wrong PIN attempts may wipe a device (some models intentionally
destroy private keys after X failed attempts). Follow these steps:
* If you know the PIN but login fails, reboot and try again.
* If you forgot the PIN, follow the [reset-pin-device][107] flow and restore from your seed phrase
  using [restore & recover wallet][108].

Pro tip: If you are unsure whether your seed phrase is complete, check it before initiating a full
restore (you can use offline tools to verify backup integrity — see [seed-phrase-management][109]).

## Firmware updates and bootloader issues

Firmware fixes bugs and improves compatibility. But firmware updates can also be the moment things
go wrong (interrupted update, corrupt file). Here’s my safe routine:
1. Confirm the update source (never use files downloaded from third-party forums). See
   [firmware-updates-bootloader][110].
2. Use a direct USB connection on a stable laptop battery (avoid phones and flaky hubs).
3. If the device enters bootloader mode and won’t finish an update, refer to
   [advanced-firmware-recovery][111] or the [error-codes-index][112].

How to verify authenticity? Check the firmware signature if the tool exposes it (some managers do).
If you’re unsure, pause and read the firmware notes (and ask in a trusted community). I believe
verification prevents many supply-chain tampering scenarios.

## Connectivity: USB, OTG, Bluetooth concerns

Different connection methods carry different risk/probability of failure.
* USB (wired): usually the most stable. If the host won’t see the device, try a powered USB hub and
  a different cable.
* OTG (mobile): check that your phone supports OTG and that the cable is data-capable.
* Bluetooth: convenient but a larger attack surface (paired devices, OS bugs). If you don’t need
  wireless, use USB.

For stepwise mobile troubleshooting see [mobile-android-troubleshoot][113] and general connectivity
notes at [usb-otg-bluetooth][114].

But remember: using Bluetooth comes down to a threat-model choice. I usually disable wireless
features for long-term cold storage.

## Overview

If your cryptocurrency is sitting on a hardware wallet and something goes wrong, calm helps more
than panic. This troubleshooting hub covers practical steps I use when a USB/OLED hardware wallet
doesn't do what I expect: won’t boot, won’t pair, refuses firmware updates, or shows suspicious
behavior. I’ve tested multiple devices since 2018 and learned that most problems are solvable with
clear steps (and some patience). What I've found: a methodical approach saves coins.

This page focuses on common faults and recovery patterns. For step-by-step setup or a full recovery
walkthrough see the [setup guide][103] and [restore & recover wallet][104] pages.

## Quick fixes: setup & unboxing

Common symptoms immediately after unboxing:
* Device won't power on or stays on a black screen.
* No recognition on desktop or mobile.
* Setup freezes during create/restore.

Quick checks I run first:

[[Try Tangem secure wallet →]][105]
1. Try a different USB cable and port. Cheap cables can be power-only.
2. Boot the host computer in normal mode (not guest/VM) and watch for driver prompts.
3. Confirm you have the official setup steps from the [setup-unboxing][106] page (never follow a
   random YouTube shortcut).

And one more: test on a second machine (or mobile via OTG) to rule out host-side problems.

## PIN, reset, and recovery flow

PIN problems are common. Forgetting a PIN does not mean loss of funds — if you have your seed phrase
you can always recover. But repeated wrong PIN attempts may wipe a device (some models intentionally
destroy private keys after X failed attempts). Follow these steps:
* If you know the PIN but login fails, reboot and try again.
* If you forgot the PIN, follow the [reset-pin-device][107] flow and restore from your seed phrase
  using [restore & recover wallet][108].

Pro tip: If you are unsure whether your seed phrase is complete, check it before initiating a full
restore (you can use offline tools to verify backup integrity — see [seed-phrase-management][109]).

## Firmware updates and bootloader issues

Firmware fixes bugs and improves compatibility. But firmware updates can also be the moment things
go wrong (interrupted update, corrupt file). Here’s my safe routine:
1. Confirm the update source (never use files downloaded from third-party forums). See
   [firmware-updates-bootloader][110].
2. Use a direct USB connection on a stable laptop battery (avoid phones and flaky hubs).
3. If the device enters bootloader mode and won’t finish an update, refer to
   [advanced-firmware-recovery][111] or the [error-codes-index][112].

How to verify authenticity? Check the firmware signature if the tool exposes it (some managers do).
If you’re unsure, pause and read the firmware notes (and ask in a trusted community). I believe
verification prevents many supply-chain tampering scenarios.

## Connectivity: USB, OTG, Bluetooth concerns

Different connection methods carry different risk/probability of failure.
* USB (wired): usually the most stable. If the host won’t see the device, try a powered USB hub and
  a different cable.
* OTG (mobile): check that your phone supports OTG and that the cable is data-capable.
* Bluetooth: convenient but a larger attack surface (paired devices, OS bugs). If you don’t need
  wireless, use USB.

For stepwise mobile troubleshooting see [mobile-android-troubleshoot][113] and general connectivity
notes at [usb-otg-bluetooth][114].

But remember: using Bluetooth comes down to a threat-model choice. I usually disable wireless
features for long-term cold storage.

# An AI-native platform for end-to-end planning

RELEX provides a unified, AI-native platform that retailers, manufacturers, and wholesalers use to
improve forecast accuracy, optimize inventory, pricing, merchandising, and production, and plan
seamlessly end-to-end, from production to shelf.

By combining built-in AI and [agentic AI ][108]with deep retail and supply chain expertise, RELEX
drives smarter decisions, higher product availability, increased sales, improved sustainability, and
profitable growth at scale.

[Request a demo][109]
Why RELEX?

## What planning with RELEX
## looks like

Forecast accuracy improves because every signal, demand, supply, pricing, promotions, feeds a single
model. Inventory levels drop because replenishment decisions are automated and self-correcting.
Waste decreases because the platform sees disruptions before they become problems.

Our predictive technology responds to growing supply chain complexity and market volatility. Refined
across 600+ enterprise implementations, RELEX AI models take the guesswork out of supply chains,
using real-time data to deliver unified forecasts, automated processes, and actionable insights.

The result is planning that connects every part of an operation, not just better reports, but
decisions that actually move the business forward.

## **Explore how RELEX supports the entire consumer goods value chain**

model. Inventory levels drop because replenishment decisions are automated and self-correcting.

across 600+ enterprise implementations, RELEX AI models take the guesswork out of supply chains,
using real-time data to deliver unified forecasts, automated processes, and actionable insights.

The result is planning that connects every part of an operation, not just better reports, but
decisions that actually move the business forward.

#### Meanwhile, disruptions and existential threats are continuing to increase

So, what's your plan?

## SCAIR®

### The Award-Winning Pharma Supply Chain Risk Management Software for Operational Resilience

SCAIR® maps and models your business’ global supply chain relationships, so you can build
**resilience** into your supply networks, monitor compliance, and protect your organisation’s
**profits**.

This award-winning tool has been designed specifically for the unique characteristics of the
pharmaceutical industry: batch manufacture, multinational supply chains and strict medical
regulation.

**SCAIR® is the go-to product for pharma organisations – and other highly regulated industries like
insurance – that have a relentless desire to ensure business continuity and success.**
[
Read case study
][31]

## SCAIR®

### Best-in-Class Support and Consultancy from the Supply Chain Experts

SCAIR® is more than pharmaceutical supply chain risk management software. It is a new mindset
towards resilience that includes high-level consultancy from our supply chain risk experts.

Integrating and updating data between supply chain data sources can be tricky. That’s why we will
work closely with you to incorporate our innovative tool into your processes to extract invaluable
data, to power your organisation towards supply chain success.

We are supply chain risk experts and thought leaders who can also offer you pioneering strategies
and consultancy alongside or completely independent of SCAIR®, to help you develop formidable
resilience and a competitive edge.
Launched in 2006, SCAIR® was the first pharma supply chain risk management software to go to market
in the UK. Our team has worked with dozens of life sciences clients and highly regulated industries,
including FTSE 100-listed businesses and global names in Insurance and Reinsurance. Our software and
consultancy reflect this specialist insight.

## SCAIR®

### Our Award-Winning Pharma Supply Chain Risk Management Software Will Help You:

Assess Current Risk
Undertake supply node risk assessments and prioritisation plans. Generate site and supplier risk
profiles across a business' entire profile.
Visually Map Supply Chains
Get an intuitive view of end-to-end supply chains, critical supply points, and their relationships.
Assess Threat Impacts
Produce accurate business interruption loss estimates for potential supply chain disruptions.
Stress Test Supply Chains
Model multiple threat scenarios (physical, commercial, natural disaster) and quantify the impact of
risk mitigation.
Programme Insurance
Leverage data for insurance programme design.
Respond to Threats
Via natural disaster and regulatory compliance alerts.

### How SCAIR® Will Benefit
### Your Organisation

#### Make Better Decisions

Using hierarchical modeling, SCAIR® shows you how supply chain disruptions can impact product sales
and market share. You can then improve your supply chain decision making, by focusing on the value
at risk.

#### Protect Profits

SCAIR® enables finance, risk, and supply chain managers to calculate the cost of business
interruption losses should a critical supply point be lost, by drawing on existing business data.

#### Transforming Strategies

Our consultancy will help you integrate SCAIR® for maximum benefit. We can also sensitively refine
your existing strategies or offer deep-dive consultation to ensure you are resilient.

#### Develop a Competitive Edge

The latest version of SCAIR® offers practical and visual tools, such as our downstream stock
calculator and supply chain process flow diagrams, to help you rapidly develop strategic insights.

SCAIR® is more than pharmaceutical supply chain risk management software. It is a new mindset
towards resilience that includes high-level consultancy from our supply chain risk experts.

Integrating and updating data between supply chain data sources can be tricky. That’s why we will
work closely with you to incorporate our innovative tool into your processes to extract invaluable
data, to power your organisation towards supply chain success.

We are supply chain risk experts and thought leaders who can also offer you pioneering strategies
and consultancy alongside or completely independent of SCAIR®, to help you develop formidable
resilience and a competitive edge.

Respond to Threats

### Analysis of the Q4 2025 U.S. Bank Freight Payment Index

As the freight market tightens and costs rise, supply chain leaders must plan ahead, strengthen
carrier ties, and stay agile. In this episode of Supply Chain Now, Scott Luton and special guest
host Karin Bursa sit down with Bobby Holland of U.S. Bank and Nick Palmucci of Ferguson Enterprises
to discuss the latest U.S. Bank Freight Payment Index for Q4 2025. They unpack what “freight market
tightening” looks like in practice, with capacity shrinking, shipper spend climbing, and regional
performance moving in different directions, from strength in the Northeast to weakness in the
Southwest. They also get into what’s driving demand shifts and cost pressure, including changes in
consumer behavior, softer manufacturing signals, and uncertainty that keeps teams on their toes.
Along the way, they share practical moves leaders can make right now, such as building a three-year
roadmap, reducing spreadsheet dependency, locking in bids earlier, and operating like a shipper of
choice when capacity gets tight. The result is a grounded look at what the data shows, what shippers

# Move production out of China without losing quality or control.

Thailand Sourcing Services helps Western companies shift tooling and production into Thailand, align
the right factory partners, and keep shipments moving under one accountable team on the ground.

[Schedule an intro call][6] [View sourcing services →][7]
**25+ years** export and sourcing experience **Bangkok / Oregon** coverage for US and EU clients
**China+1** strategy for manufacturers and distributors

## Why Thailand and why now

Most companies are overexposed to China but do not have time or bandwidth to build a new supply base
from zero. Thailand offers a stable, export-oriented alternative with strong clusters in metals,
plastics, rubber, and ag-related products.

Established export infrastructure
US and EU buyers already active
Competitive labor and energy costs
Relationship-driven factory culture

## Where Thailand Sourcing Services fits

We sit between your team and the Thai factory floor so you are not relying on a random trading
company or hoping that a list of factories turns into a real supply chain.

### Factory identification and vetting

Targeted search, screenings, and shortlists of real factories that can actually build your product
at scale.

### RFQs, samples, and tooling

Coordinated RFQs, controlled sampling, and help with transferring or setting up tooling in Thailand.

### Production and logistics follow-through

Hands-on follow-up with factories and coordination with forwarders so product ships correctly and on
time.

## Typical client profiles

### US manufacturers

OEMs and brands that need to move a portion of their supply out of China while keeping existing
customers supplied.

### Distributors and importers

Category owners for industrial, garden, outdoor, or ag products who want a second source in
Southeast Asia.

### Private label and new launches

Teams with defined product specs and channels, but no reliable production base in Thailand yet.

## Start with a short discovery call

If you have a real product and a real need for a China+1 or Thailand strategy, a 20–30 minute
conversation is usually enough to see whether there is a clear path forward.

## Talk through your product and constraints

No sales script, just a detailed, direct discussion about what you need to move and what timelines
you are facing.

# The AI and data infrastructure for global trade

Trademo turns the world's trade data into AI-driven decisions, so you stay compliant, source
smarter, win new business, and see every tier of your supply chain

[Talk to Sales][26]
[Trademo trade intelligence illustration]

## Trusted by global trade teams

[Coface][Linklogis][Intersurgical][John Hancock][Archroma][JSL][Drip Capital][C.R. England]

## Global trade is breaking under its own complexity

### Compliance moves slower than the rules

Screening, classification, rules of origin, and duty decisions still run by hand, across data
scattered in PDFs and legacy systems. Every gap is a penalty, a detention, or a tariff you overpaid.

### You can't act on data you can't trust

Sourcing a new supplier or finding your next customer means working from trade data that's
fragmented and out of date. The opportunity is real, but it's buried in data you can't reach in
time.

### Your supply chain goes dark past Tier-1

The risk that hurts most sits two or three tiers down: a sanctioned owner, a forced-labor link, a
disruption you never see coming. By the time it surfaces, it has already reached you.

## Everything you need to run global trade

Global Trade Management

### Run your entire compliance operations in one place

From classification to customs, automated and audit-ready
* Classify every product accurately. Assign HS and ECCN codes across jurisdictions with AI, backed
  by justification your team can defend in an audit.
* Screen everyone you trade with. Check suppliers, customers, and owners against sanctions, PEP,
  denied-party, and ownership lists.
* Know the true cost before you ship. Calculate duties, tariffs, and landed cost from 140+
  countries, and find savings hidden in trade agreements.
* Stay ahead of controls and forced-labor rules. Manage export licenses, monitor embargoes, and
  check your supply chain before goods move.

[Explore Global Trade Management→][27]
[Global Trade Management product]
Intel

### Turn trade activity into a pipeline

Find the right companies to sell to before your competitors do
* See where demand is emerging. Track companies entering new markets, growing shipment volumes, or
  shifting suppliers across trade flows.
* Research accounts by asking. Let Hermès AI surface in-market companies and lookalike accounts
  drawn from real trade behavior.
* Focus on the accounts worth your time. Score opportunities on shipment frequency, trade volume,
  and lane fit.
* Catch buying moments others miss. Get alerted when an account adds a trade lane, grows volume, or
  changes suppliers.

## Global trade is breaking under its own complexity

### Compliance moves slower than the rules

Screening, classification, rules of origin, and duty decisions still run by hand, across data
scattered in PDFs and legacy systems. Every gap is a penalty, a detention, or a tariff you overpaid.

### You can't act on data you can't trust

Sourcing a new supplier or finding your next customer means working from trade data that's
fragmented and out of date. The opportunity is real, but it's buried in data you can't reach in
time.

### Your supply chain goes dark past Tier-1

The risk that hurts most sits two or three tiers down: a sanctioned owner, a forced-labor link, a
disruption you never see coming. By the time it surfaces, it has already reached you.

## Everything you need to run global trade

Global Trade Management

### Run your entire compliance operations in one place

From classification to customs, automated and audit-ready
* Classify every product accurately. Assign HS and ECCN codes across jurisdictions with AI, backed
  by justification your team can defend in an audit.
* Screen everyone you trade with. Check suppliers, customers, and owners against sanctions, PEP,
  denied-party, and ownership lists.
* Know the true cost before you ship. Calculate duties, tariffs, and landed cost from 140+
  countries, and find savings hidden in trade agreements.
* Stay ahead of controls and forced-labor rules. Manage export licenses, monitor embargoes, and
  check your supply chain before goods move.

[Explore Global Trade Management→][27]
[Global Trade Management product]
Intel

### Turn trade activity into a pipeline

Find the right companies to sell to before your competitors do
* See where demand is emerging. Track companies entering new markets, growing shipment volumes, or
  shifting suppliers across trade flows.
* Research accounts by asking. Let Hermès AI surface in-market companies and lookalike accounts
  drawn from real trade behavior.
* Focus on the accounts worth your time. Score opportunities on shipment frequency, trade volume,
  and lane fit.
* Catch buying moments others miss. Get alerted when an account adds a trade lane, grows volume, or
  changes suppliers.

Source Atlas

### Find and qualify suppliers on real trade data

Real trade activity tells you more than any supplier profile
* Pick the right market first. Compare sourcing countries on trade activity, pricing, and tariff
  exposure before you commit.
* Discover suppliers by asking. Tell Hermès AI what you're sourcing and get qualified suppliers
  drawn from real shipment behavior.
* Validate before you onboard. Build a full view of each supplier with trade history, ownership
  risk, and a trade health score.
* Track markets in real time. Monitor competitor sourcing and pricing shifts, and switch while
  alternatives are still open.

[Explore Source Atlas→][29]

Map

### See past your direct suppliers

Catch the risk hiding deeper in your supply chain.
* Map every tier. Trace your supply chain up to Tier-4, upstream and downstream, across suppliers,
  sub-suppliers, and customers.
* Expose forced-labor risk. Screen against UFLPA and Xinjiang-linked shipments, and follow ownership
  ties that list checks miss.

  countries to surface indirect links to restricted entities.
* Reduce concentration risk. Spot over-dependence on a single supplier, region, or route, and
  diversify before disruption hits.

## We’re combining the world’s largest network of client and contractor relationships with risk

From hiring to hazard prevention, organizations across the globe rely on Veriforce to reduce
incidents and keep workers safe. For us, it’s the only way to work.

#### Safer, Smarter, and Faster Operations

Our roots in safety and compliance mean every process and solution we deliver is designed to protect
people and improve performance. From predictive analytics to real-time validation, we provide the
clarity to prevent incidents and get work done right the first time.

#### Global Insights, Local Action

Veriforce brings together the world’s largest network of clients and contractors. Our platform
adapts to your needs, giving you both the big picture of your supply chain risk – and the finer
details like which workers are best for each job.

#### Partnered Execution

Our experts—many with first-hand industry experience—work alongside you and your contractors to
unlock the full value of your risk management program.

## Transform Compliance into a Performance Driver

We give you the visibility, insights, and expert support to stay ahead of site risks and work with
confidence. As a hiring client, you’ll see safer operations and lower risk. If you’re a contractor,
we can help you grow by connecting you to more, better work with trusted global clients.

### Hiring Clients

Protect your people and your reputation with complete visibility across your supply chain. We can
help you manage safety, compliance, and ESG from a single place, backed by unmatched data and
proactive support.

[Discover Our Solutions][68]

### Contractors

Connect with leading global clients, showcase your qualifications, and win more work. By joining the
Veriforce Network, you simplify compliance and get more opportunities to win new business and grow

# AI agents make you fly. Wing makes the flight safe.

Get total visibility and control over your AI agents before risk becomes a breach.

[Request a demo][59]
[Wing Security shield of protection]

### Leading organizations choose Wing.

## AI agents are the new identity gap.

Most enterprises have no clear inventory of their AI agents, no mapping of their permissions, and no
visibility into how they actually behave across the stack.

AI agents break the traditional security model. They operate autonomously, often bypassing
authorization boundaries.

[control icon]

When agents are over permissioned, unmonitored, or shared, a single prompt can lead to a
cross-platform breach.

[control icon]
Wing gives you control over AI agent identities, permissions, and behavior before small gaps become
major incidents.
[Request a demo][60]
[platform image showing layers of discovery, misconfigurations and identity threat detection and
response]
VISIBILITY & CONTROL

## Wing’s AI agent security platform has 3 layers of visibility and remediation

**Step 1: Deep Discovery **of all AI usage across your stack – from tools to features to agents –
all compiled in your AI inventory.

**Step 2: Behavior Analysis of every identity accessing your systems, monitoring permissions,
access, and cross-app actions.**

****Step 3:** **Instant**** Remediation **to detect and respond immediately to suspicious behavior
or over-permissioned agents. **

[Explore platform][61]
**VISIBILITY LAYER**

## Deep Discovery

**Eliminate Shadow Agentic AI.**  Gain an accurate inventory of agents (n8n, Copilot, Claude, Glean,
etc.) in your environment.
**ANALYSIS LAYER**

## Behavior Analysis

**Detect Bypasses.**  Identify gaps where agent actions conflict with permissions or bypass
authorization boundaries.
**CONTROL LAYER**

## Instant Remediation

**Detect & Respond to Threats.** Respond in real-time to threats like instant token revocation and
API key management.

## Talk with a Wing Security expert

Let’s have a quick chat and show you Wing in action.

[Request﻿ a demo][62]

## Everything you need for agent security. In one solution.
* **Deep Agent Visibility: **Integrates with Microsoft Copilot, Claude, n8n, Tray.io, Glean, and
  more so you see what agents can access and how they operate.
* **Risky Agent Behavior Detection: **Uses Identity Behavior Analysis (IBA) to surface suspicious
  behavior like privilege escalation, access patterns, or unexpected actions.
* **Connection Mapping: **Detects the third-party platforms, apps, and integrations each agent can
  access, so you can uncover hidden exposure and reduce blind spots.
* **Automated Threat Response: **Revoke API keys and tokens from one place to quickly contain risky
  or unauthorized agent activity before it turns into an incident.

## Agent Discovery

**Centralized inventory via native integrations.
**
A continuously updated inventory of AI agent in your environment. We connect natively to agent
factories, IdPs, SaaS, and cloud platforms to map ownership, origin, and access permissions.

Because agents don’t sit still: they’re created, modified, and granted permissions constantly. Live
inventory is critical so that every decision is based on what’s actually happening, not outdated or
incomplete data.

[Explore platform][63]
[platform image showing layers of discovery, misconfigurations and identity threat detection and
response]

## Agent Access Control

**Managing granular permissions for identified agents.**

Take control of how AI agent accesses your environment. Define and enforce granular permissions
across your IdP, SaaS stack and cloud to limit what agents can reach.

So a single over-permissioned agent doesn’t turn into a full-scale breach.

[Explore platform][64]
[platform image showing layers of discovery, misconfigurations and identity threat detection and
response]

**Continuous behavioral analysis.**

Monitor how an AI agent actually behaves, not just what it was supposed to do. We analyze activity
against the original prompt to surface logic deviations and unauthorized privilege escalation.

So threats are stopped early, before they spread across your environment.
